title: Robust Variance Estimation in Linear Regression: A Projection-Geometry Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2609.01804v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inference in linear regression commonly treats OLS residuals as proxies for unobserved errors. This approximation can fail when the regression projection is nonlocal relative to the error-dependence structure. Residualization then shifts covariance information across observations and clusters, while conventional heteroskedasticity-consistent (HC) and cluster-robust variance estimators (CRVE) retain only diagonal or within-cluster residual moments and may therefore understate sampling uncertainty.   This paper develops a projection-geometry framework for robust variance estimation. The variance of the OLS estimator is represented exactly as a Riesz functional of latent covariance blocks, and observable residual moments are linked to the target through a linear operator determined by the full regression projection. translated_title: 线性回归中的稳健方差估计：投影几何视角
translated_abstract: 线性回归中的统计推断通常将OLS残差作为未观测误差的替代。当回归投影相对于误差依赖结构呈非局部性时，这种近似可能失效。此时残差化会将协方差信息在不同观测和聚类之间转移，而传统的异方差一致(HC)估计量和聚类稳健方差估计量(CRVE)仅保留对角线上或聚类内的残差矩，因此可能低估抽样不确定性。本文为稳健方差估计建立了一个投影几何框架。OLS估计量的方差被精确地表示为潜在协方差块的Riesz泛函，且可观测的残差矩通过由完整回归投影所确定的线性算子与目标量联系起来。这一表述将方差估计归结为一个线性逆问题。我提出了一个Riesz方差估计量，它结合了w……
tldr: 本文提出投影几何框架，将OLS估计量的方差精确表示为潜在协方差块的Riesz泛函，把稳健方差估计归结为线性逆问题，并据此提出Riesz方差估计量，以解决传统HC与聚类稳健估计量因忽略跨观测、跨聚类协方差信息而低估抽样不确定性的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a projection-geometry framework that represents the OLS variance exactly as a Riesz functional of latent covariance blocks, reducing robust variance estimation to a linear inverse problem and proposing a Riesz variance estimator that corrects the underestimation of sampling uncertainty by conventional HC and cluster-robust estimators.
